title: AlphaGenome: predicting the effects of DNA variants
summary: The model reads sequences up to 1 million base pairs and predicts thousands of gene-regulation properties at single-letter resolution. It outperformed the best external models in 22 of 24 sequence evaluations and matched or outperformed the best in 24 of 26 variant evaluations. Stated limits: distant regulatory elements; not validated for personal genomes or clinical use.

evidence.tested: AlphaGenome was evaluated on sequence and variant-effect benchmarks against external models, outperforming in 22 of 24 and matching or exceeding in 24 of 26 evaluations, plus a TAL1 case study.
evidence.unknown: The source states it is not validated for personal genomes or clinical use, distant regulatory elements remain a challenge, and cell-specific patterns need improvement.
evidence.ai_role: A model takes up to 1 million DNA base pairs and predicts thousands of genomic tracks and variant effects.
